fusions.name: Venom Spit
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiling Squeeze
fusions.desc: Wraps the target for 16 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It has an 80% chance of [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Patient Venom
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them, and you resist poison damage by 10%.
